Hi James — great to hear. Happy to run the kickoff and walk through the MAP so the procurement and legal teams have everything they need.

I can do Tuesday 17 Feb at 10:00 AM PT or Thursday 19 Feb at 9:00 AM PT — which works better for your team? We’ll plan 45 minutes. I’m looping in Rishi (Sales Lead) and Priyom (Solutions/Implementation) so we can cover dedicated provisioning timelines and the PO flow.

Proposed agenda (draft):
1) Introductions & objectives (5m) — confirm decision owners and approvers
2) Vendor setup checklist (marissa) (10m) — onboarding form, tax/vendor questions, W-9/contract routing
3) PO process & billing (rishi) (10m) — invoicing cadence, billing contact, purchase order fields we need
4) Dedicated provisioning timeline & capacity model (priyom) (10m) — from signed PO to capacity ready, SLA expectations
5) MAP / milestones & next steps (all) (8m)
6) Q&A and action items (2m)

Attachments I’m sending now:
- redwood_procurement_onboarding_form_2026.pdf (fillable onboarding form)
- PO-template-OctagonHealth.docx (sample PO fields)

If that agenda looks good, confirm the Tuesday or Thursday slot and any additional attendees (legal, vendor ops). I’ll prepare a short MAP with milestones (PO issued -> provisioning -> go-live) that we can finalize on the call.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: prep for Octagon Health procurement kickoff

Marissa, Priyom — a few internal notes before the call:

Stakeholders to confirm (we should propose these to James):
- Procurement owner: James Holloway (Octagon)
- Technical owner: Samantha Lee (Vendor Ops)
- Legal approver: TBD (they may bring on call)
- Billing/contact for PO: Octagon AP (procure@octagonhealth.com)

Success criteria for MAP (what we should commit to):
- Redwood to receive signed PO (with redwood payee info) within 7 business days of final terms
- Dedicated capacity provisioned to customer within 10 business days after PO acceptance (dependent on model/size)
- Billing start date aligned to provisioning completion or mutually agreed date

Risks & mitigations:
- If legal requests contract changes, propose routing via counterparty addendum vs full redline to keep timeline tight.
- If AP needs net terms, highlight standard options and escalation path to finance (we can offer 30/45 net with credit check; larger terms require procurement SLA).

Priyom — can you bring a short slide or bullet list stating typical lead times for small/medium/large Dedicated pools? Also have a fallback model (hosted with committed throughput) if provisioning takes longer. Monica, please prep invoicing contact and sample invoice fields so we can show what PO line items must contain.

Thanks — Rishi

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Sales Operations
